mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hospital_doctor (user_id, name, avatar, title, department_id, introduction, expertise, qualifications, is_online, sort_order, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{title}, #{departmentId}, #{introduction}, #{expertise}, #{qualifications}, #{isOnline}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM hospital_doctor WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT d.*, dep.name AS department_name FROM hospital_doctor d LEFT JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id WHERE d.status = 1 AND d.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC
